title: LoyaltyAdjustmentCreateBody
description: Request body to perform loyalty balance adjustment

credit.description: how much loyalty to add to the balance (mutually exclusive with debit)

customer_id.description: id of a customer to perform an adjustment

debit.description: how much loyalty to subtract from the balance (mutually exclusive with credit)

reason.description: Arbitrary note that would be associated with the transaction

session_id.description:
An unique ID that prevents double adjustment (same request sent twice will be only applied once)
Must be an uuidv4
